findings.title: Discount rate is a float instead of an int
findings.body: The new `spring_price_cents` function passes `rate = 0.2` (a float) to `apply_discount`, which expects an `int` percent. This will cause a type mismatch at runtime and likely fail validation inside `apply_discount`. Pass an integer rate (e.g., 20) instead.

summary.problem: The spring sale price function passes a float discount rate to a function expecting an integer percent.
summary.done_well: The new function follows the existing pattern of calling `list_price_cents` and then applying a discount.
